messages:
maria_partnerships: starting thread — we need to align on the new cross-cloud region (eu-west-3-like) partner onboarding timeline and capacity gating. target go-live: 2026-05-12. any blockers?
ryan_infra: ping — from infra side we need confirmed SKU quotas and expected baseline qps to size the dedicated pool. rough numbers will do.
sarah_partner: partner asked for 4 reserved nodes initially, burst to 10. they want marketplace listing + joint announcement. they also need KMS integration whitelisting.
jack_saleseng: +1 on announcement. do we have a press/partner PR owner? also need to ensure pricing tiers are in the marketplace entitlements.
olivia_legal: heads-up — marketplace announcement requires partner legal sign-off and a short data processing addendum. i can draft, but need partner legal contact.
maria_partnerships: @sarah_partner can you share partner legal contact and their expected contract SLA? we should avoid last-minute legal swings.
sarah_partner: partner_legal@atlascloud.com, they already signed standard MSA but want a data addendum for KMS + audit logs. SLA target is 99.9 for region traffic.
ryan_infra: for 4 reserved nodes + burst profile, estimate 80–120 qps steady, spike to 300 qps. i'll open a quota ticket with cloud provider and request GPU SKUs: a100-80gb or h100 fallback. ticket: CLOUD-QUOTA-8842.
nate_ops: added a runbook stub to the shared ops folder. quick checklist:
```
- confirm marketplace SKU entitlements
- KMS key exchange + IAM mapping
- quota ticket created (CLOUD-QUOTA-8842)
- deploy canary to eu-west-3-ish region
- ramp plan and SLA alert thresholds
- partner announcement assets
```
maria_partnerships: perfect. who's owning the marketplace listing? we need screenshots, usage example, and a short blurb.
jack_saleseng: i can own listing content. will need a 1-paragraph technical blurb and 3 screenshots by 2026-04-15. can someone supply the example SDK snippet?
ryan_infra: i'll drop a minimal SDK snippet tonight and a canary config. snippet will include region selector + fallback policy.
sarah_partner: partner will provide a short architecture diagram and logo. i'll coordinate deliverables and legal contact.
olivia_legal: i'll draft data addendum and send to partner legal by EOD Fri. ok if i cc @maria_partnerships and @sarah_partner?
maria_partnerships: yes pls cc. also, announcement cadence: internal comms 2026-04-28, partner preview 2026-05-05, public 2026-05-12. objections?
jack_saleseng: timeline works for sales enablement if we get listing and playbook by 2026-04-22.
nate_ops: ops needs a final runbook and rollback plan 72h before public. will schedule game-day with SRE.
sarah_partner: partner requests a short tech dry-run w/ their infra team on 2026-05-03. can we slot a 90m window?
ryan_infra: tentatively yes — i'll coordinate resources and confirm by Tue.
deploy-bot: Ticket CLOUD-QUOTA-8842 updated: provider requested justification doc. upload quota_justification_eu-west3.pdf to the ticket.
maria_partnerships: thanks @deploy-bot. action items summary:
- sarah: partner assets + legal contact (due 2026-04-10)
- olivia: data addendum draft (due 2026-03-28)
- ryan: quota ticket follow-up + SDK snippet (due 2026-03-29)
- jack: marketplace copy + screenshots (due 2026-04-15)
- nate: final runbook + game-day (due 2026-05-09)
- maria: coordinate announcement timeline and internal comms (ongoing)

Please reply in-thread with confirmations or if you want tasks reassigned. :pushpin:
